progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 6 (1:33.1) introduces Bb, centred on G. Phrase 7 (1:51.3) introduces Ak, C, centred on G. The line peaks at C5 (563.2 Hz) at 2:30.8. It closes on the tonic (Ab4 → F4 → F4 → G4 → F4 → F3).
